notes: The knockbackStrength citation points at the skeleton's ranged attack, where the field is set; the field is item_entity.h's knockback_strength and the application is living.c's arrow-hit branch (living.c 352). The entity hit (living.c:an_arrow_hit_cb) is causeArrowDamage (DMG_ARROW, the shooter as getEntity), spares the enderman the fire and flies on after it teleports, and runs func_151384_a/func_151385_b for a living shooter. lane/idxentity: ent-arrow-s1 shoots a zombie with a Power II, Punch II, Flame, Infinity bow; the punch knockback was one ulp off natively (the division order) and is now Java's. The PVP branches need a second player. lane/reloadstate: a reloaded arrow has no shootingEntity (it is not saved), so the hit is causeArrowDamage(this, this): an_arrow_hit_cb marks the target (hit_src_arrow, hit_src_x/z, the arrow's position before its move) and the knockback comes from the arrow (living.c living_attack_entity_from_attacker_base; the player's serverreplay.c sr_player_attack), not the random attackedAtYaw; arrow-reload-s1 (a zombie) and arrow-reload-player-s1 (the player) failed on master.
